title: Completed continuous section-action encoding
statement: Let ℓ be prime and E : Type u a finite normed extension of Q_ℓ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For X : Scheme u with its pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let B_X be the completed integral coefficient sheaf [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and let c : B_X ≅ (U ↦ C(|U|, O_E)) be any coefficient-sheaf ring isomorphism [def-sfb-continuous-lattice-coefficients]. The completed continuous module equivalence is the canonical continuous integral module equivalence of [def-sfb-continuous-coefficient-module-equivalence-universe], followed by transport along c to sheaves of B_X-modules. Its inverse and the inverse field encoding are additive: equivalences preserve binary products in these preadditive categories. This records the three existing constructions without changing their data or signatures.

def completedContinuousModuleEquivalence (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (c : Scheme.pbcAdicCompletion X (Scheme.pbcIntegralDatum l E) ≅
      latticeCoefficientSheaf X (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
